source: 中国地图（分省设色）1:1100万，界线版，无邻国，有河流 — Standard Map of China, Ministry of Natural Resources of the PRC, standard map service
method: one fill per provincial-level division read from the EPS; labelled by the capital it contains; island fills joined to the nearest province; converted to lon/lat with the fitted projection

fit.projection: Albers equal-area conic, standard parallels 25N/47N (spherical) + similarity transform
